# gigahost_operating_system (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one installable operating system. Give either `slug` (e.g. `debian-12`, also accepts the codename `bookworm` or the full display name), or `distribution` + `release`. The lookup errors when zero or several OSes match, listing the valid slugs. List OSes with `gigahost deploy os`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve exactly one OS — errors when zero or several match.
data "gigahost_operating_system" "debian" {
  distribution = "debian"
  release      = "12"
}

resource "gigahost_server" "web" {
  type = "value"
  size = "2c-4gb-40gb"
  os   = data.gigahost_operating_system.debian.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `distribution` (String) Distribution to search, e.g. `debian`. Filled with the resolved distribution.
- `release` (String) Release within the distribution, e.g. `12` or `24.04`.
- `slug` (String) OS slug for `gigahost_server.os`, e.g. `debian-12`. Filled with the canonical slug when resolved via `distribution`.

### Read-Only

- `arch` (String) CPU architecture the image targets.
- `codename` (String) Distribution codename, e.g. `bookworm`.
- `custom_partition` (Boolean) True when the image supports custom partitioning.
- `dedicated_only` (Boolean) True when the image can only be installed on dedicated hardware.
- `min_ram_gb` (Number) Minimum memory in GB this image requires.
- `name` (String) Operating system name, e.g. `Debian 12 64-bit`.
